subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: 'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous folk festival/funfair held in Munich.

questions.q: How do you say 'There is a swimming pool in my town'?
options: In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Schwimmbad
In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Rathaus
In meiner Stadt gibt es einen Bahnhof
In meiner Stadt fehlt ein Schwimmbad
questions.explain: 'Es gibt' = 'there is' and 'das Schwimmbad' = 'the swimming pool'.
'Die Gegend' means 'the area/region/neighbourhood', e.g. 'eine ruhige Gegend' = 'a quiet area'.
'Das Rathaus' means 'the town hall' (from 'Rat' = council), not anything to do with rats.
'Die Reise' means 'the journey/trip'; 'der Reis' (rice) is the near-miss.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to book a double room'?
questions.explain: 'Buchen' = 'to book' and 'ein Doppelzimmer' = 'a double room'; 'Einzelzimmer' (single) and 'absagen' (cancel) are distractors.

questions.q: How do you say 'The hotel was right by the beach'?
options: Das Hotel ist direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt am Strand
Das Hotel war direkt an der Straße
Das Hotel war weit vom Strand
questions.explain: 'War' = 'was', 'direkt am Strand' = 'right by the beach'; 'Straße' (street) is the trap.
'Die Fahrkarte' is a travel 'ticket'; 'die Landkarte' = map, 'der Führerschein' = driving licence.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have lived here for ten years'?
options: Ich wohne seit zehn Jahren hier
Ich wohnte vor zehn Jahren hier
Ich wohne hier seit zehn Tagen
Ich werde hier zehn Jahre wohnen
questions.explain: 'Seit' + present tense = 'for/since'; 'seit zehn Jahren' = 'for ten years'.
'Die Einwohner' means 'the inhabitants/residents' of a place.

questions.q: How do you say 'My town is too noisy'?

questions.explain: 'Im Ausland' means 'abroad'. 'Das Ausland' = foreign countries; 'das Inland' = home country.
